name: MobileAPI
description: A REST API with specs, images and prices for 30,000+ phones, tablets, smartwatches and laptops from 200+ brands. It offers fuzzy search with match scoring, autocomplete and manufacturer filters. 200 free requests a month, then Pro $15/mo for 10k requests, then Enterprise (company-stated). "One API call instead of scraping five different websites." Founded Sep 2022, GB, Django + Postgres.

mentions.evidence: ~$4,806 MRR (+15.3% L30), 120 active subscriptions, ~$4,678 L30, ~$36,479 last 12 months, ~$56,907 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 8, 2026 ~06:06 Warsaw (04:06 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Pick a dataset devs keep scraping and sell it as a clean API with a $15 tier, for example EU car models/trims with specs (for insurance and leasing quote forms) or EU e-vignette/toll prices per country. The work is the normalisation, and that's also the moat.

whyItPrints: It sells a cleaned-up dataset to developers building comparison sites, refurb/trade-in tools and telecom shops. Once it's wired into someone's product, it stays. 120 subs at ~$40/mo average (my calculation), and MRR is up 15.3% in L30.
